## Checklist

- [ ] Description says `Closes #<proposal issue>` (or `Refs #<proposal issue>` if more pull requests are coming for it)
- [ ] `make check` passes (CI runs it on every pull request)
- [ ] Reviewer ran the proposal's completion test and it passed
- [ ] If this adds something others will use, the README explains how
- [ ] If you solved something non-obvious, add a learning to `docs/solutions/`
